Target company: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: Integrity and Transparency Reports, First Quarter 2023.

Decision cutoff: 2023-05-17T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Integrity and Transparency Reports, First Quarter 2023. Published date: 2023-05-17. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2023/05/integrity-and-transparency-reports-q1-2023.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Today, we’re publishing our first quarter reports for 2023, including the Community Standards Enforcement Report, Oversight Board Quarterly Update , Transparency Report for the second half of 2022 ( Intellectual Property , Government Requests ) and Widely Viewed Content Report . All of these reports are available in our Transparency Center . The Oversight Board has been a valuable source of external perspective and accountability for Meta for over two years — and they continued to provide significant impact in the first quarter of 2023. We are also reviewing the board’s recommendations and will respond publicly within 60 days of their decision. While we did not see a material increase in case reviews and decisions during the first quarter of this year compared to previous quarters, we hope that the board will significantly increase its output next quarter and beyond.
